subject: How can I display (not just read data from) a Google Spreadsheet in a Chunk? (Spreadsheet has merged cells)

messages.author: 8b3d65bbfd09f2e1
messages.subject: How can I display (not just read data from) a Google Spreadsheet in a Chunk? (Spreadsheet has merged cells)
parts:
Hello, 

How can I visually display a Google Spreadsheet in a chunk? I don't just want to read the data in the chunk, I actually want to visually display the spreadsheet. In other words, the spreadsheet is part of the "narrative" as well as the source code. Either a Latex/pdf or a Markdown/html solution is fine with me. Converting it to .csv is not a solution for me, because my spreadsheet has merged cells (which my R code can parse correctly).

Probably any solution that can display a spreadsheet with merged cells, but still treat it as source code will work for me. I do not want to break the "knit/weave" paradigm.

Thanks
